'''Joiya al'Thor''' was the daughter of [[Egwene al'Vere]] and [[Rand al'Thor]] during Egwene's test for [[Accepted]].{{ref/book|3|22}}

==Appearance==
Egwene sees Joiya as the most beautiful and sweetest little girl in the Two Rivers.

==Activities==
Egwene reluctantly leaves Joiya and Rand behind when the arch appears that is her exit from her first trip in the [[Silver arches]].

Egwene does not like that [[Black Ajah]] member [[Joiya Byir]] shares her hypothetical daughter's name. {{ref/book|3|25}}

== In the television series ==
In the television series, {{TVlink|Joiya al'Thor}} is played by an uncredited infant, and appeared in a vision Ishamael showed Rand, rather than than one Egwene experienced.
